reviews.text:
I absolutely do not recommend these "veterinarians" due to their lack of care, empathy, professionalism, and concern for their patients' recovery.

The negligence of the veterinarian and his assistant caused my kitten to develop a critical condition affecting her liver and other organs, ultimately costing her life. With a correct and timely diagnosis, she could have been saved, but unfortunately that didn't happen.

I deeply regret entrusting my kitten's life to these NEGLIGENT individuals.

I hope that, at least, they will remember my kitten, although I doubt it, because the feeling I'm left with is that they are more concerned with making a profit than with the well-being of the animals entrusted to them.

I wish that writing this could bring my beloved Negrita back to me, but unfortunately it won't bring my girl back.

At least, I hope this review helps others avoid making the same mistake and think twice before entrusting the health and lives of their animals to these "professionals."
I'm delighted with Dr. Jesus and his team. Very careful, professional, and friendly. He will remain my cats' veterinarian of choice.
Excellent treatment, very satisfied, I recommend it.
Very good service, excellent treatment of my cat, nothing bad to report 👍, thank you. …
Very helpful and attentive. Excellent service, very careful.

The owner of this clinic, unlike most others, is not at all exploitative and truly cares about the animals; he's not just there to make money. The nurse, Raquel, is incredibly kind and very responsible in her work. This clinic deserves praise; I wish all clinics were like this.

We were very well received and attended to. Our dog, a beagle, was having problems that worried us a lot, but we managed to get an appointment for the same day and had the problem solved. They even gave us much more than we imagined, with many tips, advice, and knowledge of what's best for our dog. We were very relieved and happy with the care and service we received. We will always return and recommend this clinic to everyone. It's 5 stars.

I believe that many people have a good opinion of this clinic, but I can't say the same... because a kitten I rescued from the street was taken there to be neutered, and to my despair, the kitten disappeared when he woke up from the anesthesia, and no one knew where he was. Thank God he managed to return to the home of the family that adopted him.
To make matters worse, we noticed that after the surgery he started urinating everywhere... we let a few days pass and had to take him to another clinic, which gave us a report that Coockie had incontinence problems... who is responsible now???
